title: Morning renewal triage and QBR prep - quick scratch
content: Purpose: quick morning triage — prioritize renewals + any urgent support escalations before EOD
TODAY TOP 3
[ ] SnapShelf - finalize 6/30 renewal proposal (need final pricing from finance). Hold blockers call if not received by 2pm.
[ ] LatticeData - QBR at 11:30am PT; confirm agenda + run /demo flow for 15-min latency improvements (they care about tokens/latency tradeoffs).
[ ] NovaRetail - high-severity ticket (SRE) still open; escalate to infra oncall if no progress by 10:45am.
CUSTOMER: SnapShelf (renewal target 2026-06-30)
- Current ARR: $320k; expect +8-12% with usage growth if we lock 12mo commit
- Open items: legal redlines (sec review), final e-sign invoice, discount approval from Finance (requested 2026-04-16)
- Ask finance: Can we push 10% instead of 12% to keep close? Need answer by 14:00 PT. (Diego owning)
- Quick talk track: emphasize dedicated routing SLA, token-cost savings with Redwood Optimize recommendations (show estimate) — prep bullet metrics (see 'snap-usage-estimate' sheet).
- Draft renewal email (short): 'Thanks again — attaching final SOW and 12mo pricing. If we sign by 2026-05-01 we can honor promotional credits and reserve capacity for June.'
CUSTOMER: LatticeData (QBR 11:30am PT)
- Goals: show infra improvements, confirm model-family choice, collect top 3 priorities for next quarter
- Demo plan: run 2-minute flow showing streaming latency with prefix caching enabled; highlight 20% token cost reduction in sample workload
- Pre-reqs: Prod API key (test account) — Rina to confirm access by 10:30am
- Ask product: any changes to rollout policy that affect canary behavior? I need a 1-sentence summary for slide.
SUPPORT ESCALATIONS

- NovaRetail (ticket JIRA-4521): spike on memory leak with long-context sessions. Repro steps in ticket. Action: ping infra oncall (tag @sre-oncall) and schedule 30-min deep-dive at 16:00 PT if not resolved.
- OrbitHealth: embedding job failures intermittently (error 502) — possible upstream timeout. Add diagnostic headers and request logs. Owner: me to request logs by EOD.
MEETING SCHEDULE (today)
- 09:00 Quick sync w/CS leads (15m) — go over priorities above
- 11:30 LatticeData QBR (45m) — Rina + Product + Solutions on call
- 14:00 Finance follow-up on SnapShelf discount (15m) — Diego joining
- 16:00 Deep-dive (if needed) NovaRetail infra
NOTES TO SELF (shorthand)
- Keep renewal asks concrete: $ delta + deliverable (eg. reserved capacity + 4-week onboarding doc)
- Avoid overpromising on feature roadmap — use 'investigation' framing
- For QBR, 3 slides only: outcomes, risks, ask
QUICK MESSAGES (templates)
- To legal (SnapShelf): 'Looking for final redline acceptance. If any clause blocks signing, flag it and I will facilitate a short legal sync.'
- To infra (NovaRetail): 'High-priority memory leak impacting customers. Please prioritize triage; assigning to oncall. Linking repro steps: JIRA-4521.'
UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Finance: final approval on promotional discount (10% vs 12%) — impact to lifetime value calcs?
- Product: any near-term changes to canary fallback thresholds that would affect LatticeData's test topology?
- Engineering: ETA on kv-cache fix that reduces p90 by ~30ms — can we have a one-liner status for QBR?
DATA POINTS / QUICK METRICS
- SnapShelf monthly token consumption: ~42M tokens (6% QoQ growth)
- LatticeData 95th latency last 7d: 210ms; with caching suggested config projected 160ms
- NovaRetail error spike: +120% last 4 hours correlated with long-context jobs (>8k tokens)
ACTION LOG (fill as complete)
- [ ] Send SnapShelf draft email (A) — target 10:30am
- [ ] Confirm Rina has test key for QBR — target 10:15am
- [ ] Ping infra oncall for NovaRetail — immediate
- [ ] Attach usage + Optimize recommendation PDF to renewal proposal
QUICK LINKS (for copy/paste)
- SnapShelf SOW draft: https://drive.redwood/snap-sow-drafts
- NovaRetail ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/JIRA-4521
- QBR template: https://confluence.redwood/display/CS/QBR-template
END NOTES
- Keep today tight — escalate early if any approval slips. If finance stalls, propose interim 6-week extension to protect revenue while finalizing docs.
- If time permits: prep one-pager showing cost delta between 8-bit quant + cache vs float16 for SnapShelf workload (helps negotiation).
- Personal: lunch @12:30 — block calendar so I don't get pulled into deep triage during QBR prep.
